title: Where Does Rhetorical Distortion Live? A Multi-Platform, Multi-Language Measurement of Influencer Content
abstract: arXiv:2610.26412v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Much of the manipulation in influencer content is not false but disproportionate, framing accurate facts as historic, urgent, or catastrophic. Existing approaches either verify factual claims or detect clickbait and propaganda in single-platform, single-language text; however, they overlook where such framing originates, because they treat a post and the replies beneath it as one unit. To address this gap, we measure rhetorical distortion with one instrument applied identically across six platforms and two languages, classifying creator posts and their replies separately. Our three-tier pipeline detects five literature-grounded dimensions (Significance Inflation, Anxiety Manufacturing, Novelty Claims, Loaded Language, and Temporal Distortion): bilingual lexical rules propose candidates, negative filters cancel known false positives, and an LLM verifies or relabels the candidates. translated_title: 修辞失真存在于何处？一项针对网红内容的多平台、多语言测量研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.26412v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：网红内容中的许多操纵并非虚假信息，而是不成比例的表述——它们将准确的事实包装成具有历史性、紧迫性或灾难性的内容。现有方法要么验证事实性声明，要么在单一平台、单一语言的文本中检测标题党与宣传内容；然而，这些方法忽视了此类框架化表述的来源，因为它们将帖子及其下方的回复视为一个整体。为填补这一空白，我们使用同一套测量工具，在六个平台和两种语言上进行一致的修辞失真测量，并将创作者帖子与其回复分开分类。我们的三层级流水线检测五个基于文献的维度（重要性夸大、焦虑制造、新颖性声明、情绪化语言和时间失真）：双语词汇规则提出候选样本，负面过滤器排除已知的误报，大语言模型对候选样本进行验证或重新标注。这种设计使标签保持透明且可比较（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一套在六个平台、两种语言上统一应用的修辞失真测量框架，通过双语词汇规则、负面过滤器与大语言模型验证构成的三层级流水线，检测五种修辞操纵维度，并将创作者帖子与回复分开分类，以定位此类框架化表述的真正来源。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a unified multi-platform, multi-language framework for measuring rhetorical distortion, which uses a three-tier pipeline of bilingual lexical rules, negative filters, and LLM verification to detect five distortion dimensions while separately classifying creator posts and their replies to pinpoint where such framing originates.
